PROJECT.WHAT: Agent-run engine that researches a family and tells its living history.
PROJECT.WHY: A family's agents must be able to take the method for their own family without the first family's data, taste or tooling.
PROJECT.LOAD_RULE: Pin this file. Load the one shard your task names. Load a second shard only when an edge here says your change touches it.

USECASE_START.INTENT: A new family begins from living memory, home papers and an optional GEDCOM, and reaches a first honest page.

USECASE_RESEARCH.INTENT: An agent extends a line: finds records, reads them, weighs identity and kinship, records versions with weights.

USECASE_STORY.INTENT: Evidence becomes a feed: scenario, text, document cut-outs, drawings, translations.

USECASE_READ.INTENT: A relative reads a chapter; facts, weights, doubts and the document are one tap away.

USECASE_CORRECT.INTENT: The family corrects a memory or a reading; affected pages are flagged, nothing is silently rewritten.

USECASE_TUNE.INTENT: The host changes voice, language, depth, privacy or drawing style through declared settings, never by editing the engine.

USECASE_REGION.INTENT: A family from another region plugs in a region pack.

USECASE_SHOW.INTENT: The app is shown to strangers in demo mode with a fictional family.

CAPABILITY_RULES.INTENT: Trust core, four kinds of rules, one registry of settings, one cascade, first-class exceptions.

CAPABILITY_GOVERN.INTENT: Keep this repository honest: the WHY validator and the layer boundary check.

CAPABILITY_INSTANCE.INTENT: The family root: one config from which tree, feeds, media, export and port are found; intake of GEDCOM, memory, photographs and papers.

CAPABILITY_TREE.INTENT: The family graph: snapshot, evidence, researchers' contributions and identity decisions become one graph in which every person and link says what it stands on.

CAPABILITY_ROLES.INTENT: Role entry sheets; a role receives the rules that apply to it by command. A skill lives with the capability whose work it describes.

CAPABILITY_RESEARCH.INTENT: Two research starts, cases, versions with weights, coverage.

CAPABILITY_PIPELINE.INTENT: Feed stages as data: fingerprints, stale marks, next step.

CAPABILITY_BUILD.INTENT: Validated reader bundles, permanent media and the reader app.

CAPABILITY_REGION.INTENT: Region pack contract and packs: sources, site recipes, name variants, calendars, daily-life reference.

CAPABILITY_DEMO.INTENT: A fictional family that goes from zero to a first chapter; test data and the public face.

CAPABILITY_HOST.INTENT: The interface Familiar needs from the host environment: a model tier per role and a gate before launching an agent. The tooling itself lives outside.
